## 中文原文
傍晚你在家准备给宝宝洗澡，放好温水、试了水温，刚把宝宝抱进浴盆，他一把抓住浮在水面的小黄鸭玩具，开心地拍起水花，把你的袖子都溅湿了。

## My translation
I was going to give my baby a bath this evening.
I prepared warm water and made sure the temperature was good.
I'd just put him in the bath hub when he catched the little duck floating on the water, and patted the water happily.
As a result, my sleeves were wet.

## Revised version
I was going to give my baby a bath this evening.
I got the warm water ready and checked that the temperature was just right.
I'd just lowered him into the bathtub when he grabbed the little rubber duck floating in the water and started splashing happlily.
Before I knew it, my sleeves were soaked.

## Key phrases
- get sth. ready
- right temperature
- bathtub
- lower
- grab
- little rubber duck
- floating in the water
- start splashing
- sleeves
- soaked，浸湿了
